_about: Source of truth for the HyperDX dashboard 'Loom — Code Plane'. Provision with the ClickStack MCP (clickstack_save_dashboard, then clickstack_save_alert per tile that carries an `alert`). Each tile lists the source it queries and the exact SQL; run it through clickstack_query_tile before saving. Metric and attribute names are those emitted by server/observability/metrics.py, server/code/app/common.py and server/workers/status.py; grep for the name before renaming anything here. Agent dimension: `loom.code.consumer` (the caller's self-declared consumer tag), `loom.agent` (SDK Agent name, '-' when unset), `enduser.id` (token principal, also Langfuse userId); outcomes carry `source`.
name: Loom — Code Plane

tiles.title: Fast-tier watermark age by namespace (s) — informational, see lag
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS t, Attributes['loom.namespace'] AS ns, max(Value) AS age_s FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'loom.code.index_age_seconds' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY t, ns ORDER BY t

tiles.title: Compiler-tier watermark age by namespace (s) — informational, see lag
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS t, concat(Attributes['loom.namespace'], ' ', MetricName) AS series, max(Value) AS age_s FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('loom.code.scip_age_seconds', 'loom.code.scip_py_age_seconds') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

tiles.title: Fast-tier lag: commits between branch tip and index, by namespace
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS t, Attributes['loom.namespace'] AS ns, max(Value) AS lag_commits FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'loom.code.index_lag_commits' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY t, ns ORDER BY t

alert.name: code index stale
alert.why: The ingest poller indexes up to 20 commits per 120 s pass; more than 20 behind for 15 min means the poller or the fetch is wedged. Age-based alerting would be wrong here: a release branch with no new commits is current however old its last one.

tiles.title: Compiler-tier lag: commits between fast tier and each compiler tier, by namespace and tier
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS t, concat(Attributes['loom.namespace'], ' ', Attributes['tier']) AS series, max(Value) AS lag_commits FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'loom.code.scip_lag_commits' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

alert.name: compiler tier stale
alert.why: A compiler-tier producer runs about every 30 min and indexes up to 200 translation units per pass; more than 200 commits behind for 2 h means the worker, the fetch or the tier's producer is wedged (a stalled submodule fetch, for example). Override and caller answers silently degrade to the parser tier meanwhile.

tiles.title: Tier lag (s): age of the oldest commit each tier has not reached, by namespace and tier
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS t, concat(Attributes['loom.namespace'], ' ', Attributes['tier']) AS series, max(Value) AS lag_s FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'loom.code.tier_lag_seconds' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

alert.name: code tier lag
alert.why: A consumer that waits for commit_coverage.ready on a new merge waits on the slowest tier. This gauge is the age of the oldest commit a tier has not reached, measured from the watermark rows and the mirror, never from a producer's log: a watermark that stops while git_head moves grows it without bound, while the producer can keep logging that it is current. min over the window keeps a normal cycle (commit lands just after a pass) from paging; 30 min is the default. Tier `fast` is the ingest poller against the fetched tip; the others are compiler tiers against git_head. Keep the threshold above the slowest tier's normal cycle (producer interval plus run time).

tiles.title: Failing tiers: failed passes in a row, by namespace, tier and error kind
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS t, concat(Attributes['loom.namespace'], ' ', Attributes['tier'], ' (', Attributes['kind'], ')') AS series, max(Value) AS failed_passes FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'loom.code.tier_failing' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

alert.name: code tier failing
alert.why: A tier that fails on every pass falls behind, and the lag gauges only say how far behind it is, not why. The series is the run of failed passes, labelled with the error kind and severity, and reports exactly the tiers /v1/health's code_tier_failing problem reports, so its thresholds are the LOOM_CODE_TIER_FAILING_* settings; that problem and code.repos tier_health carry the fix. A tier stops reporting on its next successful pass.

tiles.title: Stale files: indexed paths whose chunks predate their last change, by namespace
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS t, Attributes['loom.namespace'] AS ns, max(Value) AS stale_files FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'loom.code.stale_files' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY t, ns ORDER BY t

alert.name: code index content drift
alert.why: Watermarks count commits walked, not rows refreshed: every lag gauge can read 0 while a large share of function rows carry stale line numbers. The ingest worker reconciles hourly and heals up to 200 paths per pass, so a count above 200 for 3 h means drift is outpacing repair (or the heal is failing) and positional answers (code.symbol lines, code.enclosing, grep shim) are wrong for those files.

tiles.title: PR-history cursor age (s)
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS t, Attributes['loom.namespace'] AS ns, max(Value) AS age_s FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'loom.code.pr_cursor_age_seconds' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY t, ns ORDER BY t

tiles.title: Files the indexer could not process
tiles.sql: SELECT Attributes['loom.namespace'] AS ns, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS files_errored FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'loom.code.files_errored' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY ns

tiles.title: Code ops per 5 min, by operation
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS t, SpanAttributes['loom.operation'] AS op, count() AS calls FROM default.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId = '' AND SpanAttributes['loom.operation'] LIKE 'code.%' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY t, op ORDER BY t

tiles.title: Who is calling: per consumer/agent calls, p95 and abstain rate
tiles.sql: SELECT coalesce(nullIf(SpanAttributes['loom.code.consumer'], ''), nullIf(SpanAttributes['loom.agent'], '-'), SpanAttributes['enduser.id']) AS who, SpanAttributes['loom.operation'] AS op, count() AS calls, round(quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1e6)) AS p95_ms, round(countIf(SpanAttributes['loom.code.abstain'] = 'true') / count(), 3) AS abstain_rate FROM default.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId = '' AND SpanAttributes['loom.operation'] LIKE 'code.%' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY who, op ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 40

tiles.title: p50 / p95 per code op (ms) — compare with budget_p99_ms in server/code/api/ops.py
tiles.sql: SELECT SpanAttributes['loom.operation'] AS op, count() AS calls, round(quantile(0.5)(Duration / 1e6)) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1e6)) AS p95_ms, round(quantile(0.99)(Duration / 1e6)) AS p99_ms FROM default.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId = '' AND SpanAttributes['loom.operation'] LIKE 'code.%' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY op ORDER BY calls DESC

tiles.title: Where code.callers spends its time (child spans, p95 ms)
tiles.sql: SELECT SpanName, count() AS n, round(quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1e6)) AS p95_ms FROM default.otel_traces WHERE SpanName LIKE 'code.%' AND ParentSpanId != '' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY SpanName ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

tiles.title: Failed code requests by op and status
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS t, SpanAttributes['loom.operation'] AS op, SpanAttributes['http.status_code'] AS status, count() AS n FROM default.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId = '' AND SpanAttributes['loom.operation'] LIKE 'code.%' AND toUInt16OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.status_code']) >= 400 AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY t, op, status ORDER BY t

tiles.title: Share of code answers served from a stale index
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) AS t, round(countIf(SpanAttributes['loom.code.stale'] = 'true') / count(), 3) AS stale_share, count() AS answers FROM default.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId = '' AND SpanAttributes['loom.operation'] LIKE 'code.%' AND mapContains(SpanAttributes, 'loom.code.stale') AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

tiles.title: Abstain / ambiguous rate by op (loom.code_search_trace)
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, op, round(countIf(abstain = 1) / count(), 3) AS abstain_rate, count() AS calls FROM loom.code_search_trace WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND consumer NOT IN ('bench', 'bench-shunt', 'clickgap-replay') GROUP BY t, op ORDER BY t

tiles.title: code.search top cosine similarity, mean per 30 min
tiles.sql: SELECT t, round(sum(dSum) / greatest(sum(dCount), 1), 4) AS mean_top_similarity, sum(dCount) AS searches FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) AS t, if(AggregationTemporality = 1, toFloat64(Sum), if(toFloat64(Sum) < lagInFrame(toFloat64(Sum), 1, toFloat64(Sum)) OVER w, toFloat64(Sum), toFloat64(Sum) - lagInFrame(toFloat64(Sum), 1, toFloat64(Sum)) OVER w)) AS dSum, if(AggregationTemporality = 1, toFloat64(Count), if(toFloat64(Count) < lagInFrame(toFloat64(Count), 1, toFloat64(Count)) OVER w, toFloat64(Count), toFloat64(Count) - lagInFrame(toFloat64(Count), 1, toFloat64(Count)) OVER w)) AS dCount FROM default.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'loom.search.top_similarity' AND Attributes['loom.operation'] = 'code.search' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ResourceAttributes, Attributes, StartTimeUnix ORDER BY TimeUnix)) GROUP BY t HAVING searches > 0 ORDER BY t

alert.name: code retrieval quality collapse
alert.why: 0.30 is the code abstain threshold; a mean below it means most searches are abstaining or returning noise. Latency and errors stay green. Threshold differs from memory (0.35) because code cosines run lower.

tiles.title: Worker passes by outcome
tiles.sql: SELECT t, series, sum(d) AS passes FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS t, concat(Attributes['worker'], ' ', Attributes['outcome']) AS series, if(AggregationTemporality = 1, toFloat64(Value), if(toFloat64(Value) < lagInFrame(toFloat64(Value), 1, toFloat64(Value)) OVER w, toFloat64(Value), toFloat64(Value) - lagInFrame(toFloat64(Value), 1, toFloat64(Value)) OVER w)) AS d FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'loom.worker.passes' AND Attributes['worker'] LIKE 'code_%' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ResourceAttributes, Attributes, StartTimeUnix ORDER BY TimeUnix)) GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

tiles.title: Consecutive worker failures
tiles.sql: SELECT Attributes['worker'] AS worker, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS consecutive_failures FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'loom.worker.consecutive_failures' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY worker ORDER BY consecutive_failures DESC

alert.name: code worker failing
alert.why: The supervisor only logs a DEGRADED line at three failures; this is the same signal as a page. Covers ingest, pr_history, scip apply/delta, summary, embed recovery.

tiles.title: Token shunt: hits, passes and tokens saved per day
tiles.sql: SELECT toDate(ts) AS d, countIf(action = 'shunt_hit') AS hits, countIf(action = 'shunt_pass') AS passes, sum(tokens_saved) AS tokens_saved FROM loom.code_search_outcome WHERE action IN ('shunt_hit', 'shunt_pass') AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

tiles.title: Feedback loop: outcomes per traced answer, by consumer
tiles.sql: SELECT t.consumer, count(DISTINCT t.trace_run_id) AS answers, count(DISTINCT o.trace_run_id) AS with_outcome, round(count(DISTINCT o.trace_run_id) / count(DISTINCT t.trace_run_id), 3) AS outcome_rate FROM loom.code_search_trace t LEFT JOIN loom.code_search_outcome o ON o.trace_run_id = t.trace_run_id WHERE t.ts > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY t.consumer ORDER BY answers DESC

tiles.title: Code-plane LLM spend (USD) by stage
tiles.sql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, SpanName AS stage, round(sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['gen_ai.usage.cost'])), 4) AS usd FROM default.otel_traces WHERE SpanName IN ('llm.code_answer', 'llm.code_describe', 'llm.code_summary', 'llm.code_query_expand', 'llm.inline_rerank') AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY t, stage ORDER BY t
